summary: CNL Strategic Capital, LLC filed an 8-K reporting amended credit agreement permitting repurchases of its equity and shareholder vote results on an enhanced liquidity plan. Borrower subsidiary entered a Third Amendment to a $50M revolving loan (expandable to $100M) to fund equity repurchases up to 90% of trailing six-month net investment proceeds excluding reinvested distributions. New maturity is August 15, 2026; a $62,500 fee was paid. Shareholders voted on enhanced liquidity proposal at reconvened special meeting. The filing shows an issuer seeking capital return capacity, not a definitive transactional event.
